description: Source code implementing Windows-specific SSL platform key handling, including private key wrapping, signing, and provider information retrieval within the Chromium project.

classes.name: SSLPlatformKeyCAPI
classes.description: Handles Windows CryptoAPI private key operations, including signing and algorithm preferences.

classes.name: SSLPlatformKeyCNG
classes.description: Handles Windows CNG (Cryptography API: Next Generation) private key operations, including signing and algorithm preferences.

methods.name: WrapCAPIPrivateKey
methods.description: Wraps a CryptoAPI private key into an SSLPrivateKey object.

methods.name: WrapCNGPrivateKey
methods.description: Wraps a CNG private key into an SSLPrivateKey object.

methods.name: FetchClientCertPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the private key associated with a client certificate, wrapping it into an SSLPrivateKey object.
